{{Quote|You accepted our friendship, Senator Kayl&mdash;and credits. It's time you paid us back. All we want are the housing projects you promised our people. Now.|Prakkath|<ref name="SWTORCiGC" />}}
'''Prakkath''' was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] leader of the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. When [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Vanara Kayl]] reneged on a deal she had made with the guild, Prakkath met with her in an attempt to convince her to honor their agreement, but it failed.
